test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If one trouser is offered free on the purchase of three trousers, what is the effecve discount percentage?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Discount percentage in **Buy X Get Y Free** schemes = [Free items ÷ Total items] × 100.

Here, the customer gets **1 trouser free** on buying **3 trousers**.

Total items received by the customer = 3 + 1 = 4.

Discount % = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Buy 3 Get 1 Free.

**Formulas:** Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100 | Total MP = MP of all items (purchased + free).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1213cbde5689db9c80b8dd215f59c066ab8086b868ab2c36b8dc0eaae68dff8c.png] 

⇒ Let the **Marked Price (MP)** of one trouser be 1 unit.

⇒ **Total MP** of 4 trousers = 4 units.

⇒ The customer pays for only 3 trousers, so **Selling Price (SP)** = 3 units.

⇒ **Discount** = Total MP − SP = 4 − 3 = 1 unit.

⇒ **Discount %** = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Discount in Buy X Get Y Free

The effective discount is always calculated on the **total number of articles** handed over to the customer, as the merchant incurs the cost for all of them. Formula: [Y ÷ (X+Y)] × 100.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP − Discount.</p
